definition.name: Signed C standard clock and entropy profile

steps.name: Start the finite libfetch qualification clock
Prepare pinned bindings and supported compiler containment
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Execute the actual captured standard library on current default native products
steps.run:
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_c_standard_facilities
python3 tools/qualify_c_standard_facilities.py --build-native --zig "$(command -v zig)" --wit-bindgen "$(command -v wit-bindgen)" --wasm-tools "$(command -v wasm-tools)" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-standard-facilities"

steps.name: Execute ordinary bounded stdio through the same frozen default products
steps.run:
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_c_standard_logging
python3 tools/qualify_c_standard_facilities.py --standard-logging --native-directory "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-standard-facilities/native-build/native" --native-tuple "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-standard-facilities/native-build/native/native-tuple.json" --zig "$(command -v zig)" --wit-bindgen "$(command -v wit-bindgen)" --wasm-tools "$(command -v wasm-tools)" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-standard-logging"

steps.name: Execute combined ordinary libc facilities with four explicit grants
steps.run:
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_c_standard_combined
python3 tools/qualify_c_standard_facilities.py --combined-profile --native-directory "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-standard-facilities/native-build/native" --native-tuple "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-standard-facilities/native-build/native/native-tuple.json" --zig "$(command -v zig)" --wit-bindgen "$(command -v wit-bindgen)" --wasm-tools "$(command -v wasm-tools)" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-standard-combined"

steps.name: Execute captured C23 raw resources and physical trap retirement
steps.run:
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_c_compiled_resources
python3 tools/qualify_c_standard_facilities.py --compiled-resources --native-directory "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-standard-facilities/native-build/native" --native-tuple "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-standard-facilities/native-build/native/native-tuple.json" --zig "$(command -v zig)" --wit-bindgen "$(command -v wit-bindgen)" --wasm-tools "$(command -v wasm-tools)" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-compiled-resources"
